answer: Network congestion pricing acts like an algorithmic quill, charging high tolls on low-occupancy routes to deter malicious vehicle flooding. Much like an urban relic, legacy identity tokens fail because attackers generate millions of synthetic nodes at zero marginal operational cost. Applying a capacity-restricted lotus model forces every AI agent to stake scarce compute tokens to secure bandwidth slots, shifting traffic bottlenecks so sybil floods gridlock themselves instead of the network.
